text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty page fired for service=\"inference-eu-embeddings\" (SEV2) — sustained 5xx spike for 2m. Trigger: runtime-requests-5xx > 50 in 120s. Link: https://pagerduty.example/incident/PD-99231
ashwin: I'm on it, acked in PD :white_check_mark:
ashwin: quick triage — metrics show CPU and memory on g4x-pool-3 high, KV cache evictions increasing
jordan: copying dashboards, I can run a couple queries if you want
ashwin: running `kubectl get pods -n inference -o wide | grep runtime` to check restarts
ashwin: logs show repeated `upstream returned 502` from runtime v1.8.2
maria: customer signal — two enterprise customers reported `502` errors. CS notified, no data loss reported yet
incident-bot: PagerDuty: escalation scheduled to next on-call in 5m if no owner change
selene: looking at perf profiles, recent hotpatch `prefetch-kv` landed 10m ago — could be related
ashwin: rolling back hotpatch flag `alpha_prefetch=true` -> `false` on canary
ashwin: command: `kubectl set env deploy/inference-runtime ALPHA_PREFETCH=false -n inference` (canary)
ashwin: logs (snippet): ```2026-03-17T10:03:21Z inference-runtime[svc]: kvcache: eviction_rate=0.82, upstream=502```
jordan: `curl -v` against canary shows 200s now, still 502 on some old pods
selene: starting traffic reroute: shift 20% to dedicated-pool-eu (no hotpatch) and monitor
maria: sending FYI to CSMs and support: drafting short customer-facing note
ashwin: temporarily set autoscaler min=2 for g4x-pool-3 to reduce churn
selene: canary at 20% for 3m — errors down ~75% so far, latency stable
incident-bot: PagerDuty: ownership transferred to selene (per PD handoff)
ashwin: handing primary ownership to @selene. I'll stay nearby for rollback if needed
selene: confirmed ownership. current status: canary stable, errors dropped from 48/min to 12/min in 5m
maria: customer impact reduced; preparing an interim status update for affected customers
jordan: created temporary alert to watch `kvcache_eviction_rate > 0.5` for 10m
selene: next steps: 1) keep canary for 10m, 2) roll full pool if stable, 3) postmortem
selene: assigning follow-up to infra/runtime to investigate prefetch interaction (will create JIRA)
ashwin: noted. thanks all — reassigning PD responder to selene in the incident console
maria: once selene confirms full rollback/rollout, I'll send customer update and escalate to account teams if needed
selene: taking over. will update thread every 10m or on material change :handshake:
ashwin: TY team :heart:
